newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers firm with prompt supply tight.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers firm with prompt supply tight.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices gained $2 a tonne on Monday with prompt supply tight, while prices in the rest of Europe were broadly steady, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were quoted at around $96/$97 fob as barges rose to a range of $94/$95 ex wharf.

Traders said prompt material was tight with two Rotterdam refineries not offering bunkers, continued testing of product at one independent storage site and loading delays due to congestion at another.
"Some are only offering from the tenth (of August)," one supplier said.
The market was generally quiet with some 10-15,000 tonnes of enquiries.
Hamburg fuel oil prices gained $1 a tonne, following Rotterdam gains. Prompt product remained tight.
Mediterranean bunkers were broadly stable with a number of ports seeing active business in the morning.
